headline: V26-3893: lanes share the generated files the runner can reproduce, and an integration lead sees peers merging into its target

V26-3611.title: Keep each catalog and profile sentence on its own line, so stories stop conflicting there

criteria.text: c1: Two branches that each add a sentence to the same skill's entry merge without a conflict.
c2: scripts/validate-registry.py accepts the list form and refuses an empty item.
c3: The released archives' rendered catalog and profile text is unchanged by the migration.

V26-3703.title: Say when `lead-accept --take` applies, and which grant clears an out-of-lane file before hand-off

criteria.text: handoff's writer_not_owned refusal for an out-of-lane file names the lead-own --grant for that file and lane.
lead-accept --take's help text and run-delivery SKILL.md's row say it is for a file narrowed out after hand-off, each held by a presence pin.

V26-3700.title: Pin `--take`'s path and merged refusals, `--own-co-changed` with nothing to add, and the named-only warning's last line

criteria.text: lead-accept --take on a merged story is refused with its merged message, and nothing is written.
lead-assign --own-co-changed with nothing outside the lane makes no commit and leaves the record's bytes unchanged.
With --own-co-changed, the named-only warning's last line is held exactly.

V26-3701.title: Pin `--own-co-changed`'s and `--take`'s legacy-record refusals, with nothing written

criteria.text: lead-assign --own-co-changed is refused with the "seed this record with lead-own --seed first" message, and state.json and the journal are unchanged.
lead-accept --take is refused the same way, with nothing written.

V26-3741.title: Let lanes share generated files when the runner can reproduce them

criteria.text: Test first with two lanes editing unrelated sources that change the same declared outputs. Both finish review and handoff without a claim transfer. The queue regenerates and verifies the result after the first merge moves the base.
An irreproducible edit, failed generator or attempted self-authorization by a candidate stops progression with an actionable explanation.
Existing listing digest and membership tests still pass. Adopters without the new declaration retain their current behavior.
Document the binding with a graph example and verify it through the public lane and queue commands.

V26-3616.title: Tell an integration lead when other deliveries are merging into its target

criteria.text: c1: An integration lead's status line names peer deliveries merging into its target.
c2: The lead's wait wakes when the target has been quiet after a peer merge.
c3: With no peer delivery on the target, nothing changes.

V26-3895.title: Open the delivery's live view in the host's browser pane when a delivery begins
V26-3895.why: The operator ruled on 2026-11-25 that the workflow, not the lead's memory, makes the lead open the live view at every delivery's start

criteria.text: lead-init and lead-run --resume name the one live-view URL to open in the host's browser pane, hosted first, and the skill, guide and delivery.orient hook state the rule

finish.label: The stories
finish.text: V26-3611, V26-3703, V26-3700, V26-3701, V26-3741, V26-3895 and V26-3616 land on integrate/shared-generated-files through its merge queue, each with every criterion met

finish.label: Local suite
finish.text: The full local suite passes on macOS with Python 3.11 at the integration head, with --workers 4 --budget tests/suite-budget.json

finish.label: Into main
finish.text: The integration base is reviewed for main, as the orchestrate-work guide's integration review says, merged into main, and CI's cut-release passes on the change request
